items.title: Review: Justice Dept. Opens Inquiry Into Corey Lewandowski
items.summary: The details of the inquiry remain unclear, but it is one of the rare instances in which a Trump ally or appointee has been investigated for potential wrongdoing during the president’s second term.

items.title: Review: What a 35-Hour Train Ride Reveals About Vietnam’s Future
items.summary: Vietnam is betting big on a $65 billion high-speed railway linking Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City. Construction is set to start in late 2027 and take at least a decade to complete. The line could cut the roughly 35-hour journey to just six hours. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Review: US and Israel drawing up plans to resume attacks on Iran post-election, sources say
items.summary: The White House said Thursday that the U.S. will not resume attacks on Iran before the midterm elections on Nov. 3.

items.title: Review: Cancer Vaccine Cuts the Risk of Melanoma Recurrence, Merck and Moderna Report
items.summary: Merck and Moderna released detailed results on an experimental vaccine to treat the skin cancer.

items.title: Review: New York City Passes Horse Carriage Ban, Ending a Central Park Tradition
items.summary: A passenger’s death in June became the impetus for the City Council to ban the practice, but the bill will likely face a court challenge before being implemented in 2028.

items.title: Review: New York City Bans Horse-Drawn Carriages After Decade-Long Battle
items.summary: New York’s City Council voted to ban horse-drawn carriages, ending a Central Park tourist staple dating to the 19th century after years of debate over the horses’ place on city streets. Bloomberg's Laura Nahmias explains. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Review: Rio Tinto to Spend $1.9 Billion on Australian Bauxite Expansion
items.summary: Rio Tinto Group will spend $1.9 billion to expand its bauxite mining operations in northern Australia, with the development of a new major mine to replace production from depleting projects.

items.title: Review: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Oct. 23
items.summary: Oil held its biggest gain in about a week as intensifying attacks on Saudi Arabia stoked fears of supply disruptions.

items.title: Review: Asian Stocks to Slide on Tech Rout, Bonds Rally: Markets Wrap
items.summary: Asian stocks were set to extend losses Friday, tracking a slump on Wall Street as a rout in technology giants and escalating Middle East hostilities drove investors toward the safety of bonds.
